Kerem Demirbay , Rodrigo Becão , and Cenk Tosun were all cautioned as tempers flared. South American Resilience Takes the Lead Paraguay began the match with an intensity that caught the European giants off guard. Early in the opening minutes, Júnior Alonso and Julio Enciso tested the reflexes of Manuel Neuer , forcing the veteran goalkeeper into crucial interventions. German persistence was rewarded in the 54th minute: Florian Wirtz whipped in a cross and Kai Havertz clinicaly headed it into the bottom right corner to level the score. The game then became a back-and-forth battle, with Jamal Musiala coming off the bench to try and unlock the tactical deadlock. Paraguayan goalkeeper Orlando Gill began to emerge as the hero of the encounter, denying goals to Havertz and Kimmich with acrobatic saves that kept his side in the tie as regulation time wound down. VAR Intervention and Extra-Time Deadlock Extra time was defined by high tension and exhaustion.
